what: Helper/test plan does not require tab-delimited parsing for @tsv output
scenario_or_breakage: An awk implementation using default whitespace FS will miscount files with spaces in their names, e.g. docs/user guide.md shifts additions/deletions fields and silently corrupts the line totals
suggested_fix: Require awk -F '\t' or an equivalent IFS-tab reader, and add a fixture with a filename containing a space
